title: 第12章 猎诡人组织第13章 刘倩倩的热情
content_zh:
：很快，我们一行四人便乘坐上了大巴车来到了镇上。
刚下车，看见镇上人来人往的大街，耀眼的光芒照耀在我的脸上，格外的温暖，这种感觉已经忘了多少没有经历过了。
这几天发生的事，完全改变了我人生中的印象，甚至说已经完全改变掉了我的人生！
“你们要去哪吗？”
此时一名黑车司机把车停在我们私人眼前询问着。
“去往禾殇酒楼！”
赵史一把拉开车门，示意众人上车。
我坐在车辆的中间，而刘倩倩则坐我旁边，副驾的王胖子自从下了大巴之后，便急忙买了几大包薯片，一路上疯狂的吃着薯片，怪不得会拥有这么完美的身材。
没过多久，司机师傅稳稳的把车停在了酒楼下面，王胖子甩给司机一张百元大钞，语气高傲的说道：“不用找了，剩下的给你当辛苦费！”
司机听了之后拿起王胖子的钱，急忙感谢着，并给王胖子一串号码，并表示如果以后想去哪直接打他电话，随叫随到。
我看着眼前的景象，不禁感慨，有钱好像真的可以为所欲。
司机师傅前脚一脚油门刚走，赵史便领着我们众人踏入了酒楼里，当踏入酒楼，酒楼里的装修并不属于富丽堂皇的类型，反而有一种静雅的美。
“你好，欢迎光临！”
此时一名迎宾小姐看见我们走了进来，随即迎了过来，面露微笑礼貌的问道。
赵史从包里掏出一张令牌，令牌呈古铜色，上面雕刻着猎鬼人三个字！
迎宾小姐双手接过令牌，仔细端详了许久，一改笑容对着我们说道：“你们辛苦了，女儿庄的事情已经全部处理好了吗？”
赵史听了之后点了点头，淡淡的说道：“已经处理的差不多了，不过遇见一些棘手的事情，需要向boss进行报备，麻烦带我们进去。”
迎宾小姐听了之后带我们进入了酒楼之中，上了三楼之后往左走，出现一面墙壁挡住了去路，只见迎宾小姐往左边一张瓷砖上面轻轻一按，墙壁瞬间分为两半，开出了一道狭小的通道。
刘倩倩牵着我的手径直向前走去，王胖子和赵史则在后面跟着。
没过一会儿便走到了尽头，只见眼前出现一个宽大的房间，房间里面放着一张长桌，周围放上了许多凳子，墙上则挂着许多已被写满的纸张。

而长桌的正前方坐着一名高瘦男子，百般无聊的把玩着手机仿佛在等待某人的到来。
高瘦男子见了我们到来从凳子上站了起来，急忙向我们走来。
高瘦男子走到我们面前，一脸疑惑的盯着我和王胖子问道：“赵史还有刘倩，这两位是？”
刘倩倩听了之后，便把我的事情来龙去脉，全部告诉了高瘦男子。
高瘦男子听了之后沉思了一会儿说道：“你是说这女尸幻化成你的样子，去骗他结婚？而旁边那个王胖子则是刚好出现在女儿庄？”
刘倩倩听了之后点了点头，并没有再做过多的解释。
content_en:
: Soon, the four of us got on the bus and came to the town.
As soon as I got off the bus, I saw the busy streets of the town. The dazzling light shone on my face, which made me feel extra warm. I have forgotten how much I have never experienced this feeling.
What happened in the past few days has completely changed the impression of my life, and it can even be said that it has completely changed my life!
"Are you going somewhere?"
At this time, a black car driver parked the car in front of our private eyes and asked.
"Go to Heshang Restaurant!"
Zhao Shi opened the car door and motioned for everyone to get in the car.
I sat in the middle of the vehicle, and Liu Qianqian sat next to me. Fatty Wang, who was in the passenger seat, hurriedly bought several large bags of potato chips after getting off the bus, and ate potato chips crazily along the way. No wonder he has such a perfect figure.
Not long after, the driver parked the car steadily under the restaurant. Fatty Wang threw the driver a hundred-dollar bill and said in a arrogant tone: "No need to look for it, the rest will be your hard work fee!"
After hearing this, the driver picked up Fatty Wang's money and hurriedly thanked him. He gave Fatty Wang a number and said that if he wanted to go anywhere in the future, he would just call him and he would be there at any time.
Looking at the scene in front of me, I couldn't help but sigh. It seems that if you have money, you can really do whatever you want.
As soon as the driver stepped on the accelerator, Zhao Shi led us all into the restaurant. When we stepped into the restaurant, the decoration in the restaurant was not magnificent, but had a quiet and elegant beauty.
"Hello, welcome!"
At this time, a receptionist saw us walking in, and immediately came over to greet us, smiling and asking politely.
Zhao Shi took out a token from his bag. The token was bronze in color and had the words "Ghost Hunter" engraved on it!
The welcoming lady took the token with both hands, looked at it carefully for a long time, then changed her smile and said to us: "Thank you for your hard work, have all the matters in Nerzhuang been dealt with?"
After hearing this, Zhao Shi nodded and said calmly: "It's almost done, but we encounter some difficult things and need to report them to the boss. Please take us in."
After hearing this, the welcoming lady took us into the restaurant. After going up to the third floor, we walked left. A wall appeared blocking the way. The welcoming lady pressed lightly on a tile on the left. The wall instantly split into two halves, opening a narrow passage.
Liu Qianqian took my hand and walked straight forward, while Fatty Wang and Zhao Shi followed behind.
After a while, I reached the end and saw a large room in front of me. There was a long table in the room, many stools around it, and many papers filled with writing hanging on the walls.
Sitting directly in front of the long table was a tall, thin man, playing with his cell phone in a bored manner as if waiting for someone to arrive.
The tall, thin man stood up from his stool when he saw us coming and hurriedly walked towards us.
The tall and thin man walked up to us, stared at Fatty Wang and me with a puzzled look on his face and asked: "Zhao Shi and Liu Qian, who are these two?"
After Liu Qianqian heard this, she told the tall and thin man everything about me.
After hearing this, the tall and thin man pondered for a while and said, "You mean this female corpse transformed into you to trick him into getting married? And that Fatty Wang next to him just happened to show up at the daughter's village?"
Liu Qianqian nodded after hearing this and did not explain too much.
